title: Actual integer and quotient inclusions for finite coefficient embeddings
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to F$, use their actual valuation rings, uniformizers and finite quotients from [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Define $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_E\to\mathcal O_F$ by restriction of $i$, namely $x\mapsto i(x)$; preservation of the extended absolute values makes its codomain restriction well-defined. For every $n\geq0$ define $i_n:\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{n+1})\to\mathcal O_F/(\varpi_F^{n+1})$ by $[x]\mapsto[i(x)]$. The image of the source maximal ideal is contained in the target maximal ideal, so the quotient maps are well-defined and commute with reduction. These are the existing integer and quotient inclusions, with no change of coefficient fields or valuation rings.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(1), coefficient extension; valuation and quotient constructions used by the scalar-extension blueprint.
